surface_mechanism_description: Ion exchange between Cu2S and Zn(C2H5)2 (DEZ) results in the formation of ZnS and Cu metal. Similarly, ion exchange between ZnS and Cu2DBA results in the formation of Cu2S and Zn(DBA).
evidence: We postulate that the following reactions take place between the bulk of the sulfide thin films and the opposing metalorganic precursor: Cu2S(s) + Zn(C2H5)2(g) → ZnS(s) + 2Cu(s) + C4H10(g) (1) ZnS(s) + Cu2DBA(g) → Cu2S(s) + Zn(DBA)(g) (2) Where (g) and (s) indicate whether the species is a gas or solid, respectively.
